Chronology of every recorded fact about [[ghost armor]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== City of Light ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 4''' — Ghost armor can be earned in the graveyard and protects against the powers of other Travelers.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 6''' — Simon needs the ghost armor.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 6''' — The ghost armor blocks attacks from other Travelers.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 6''' — The ghost armor does not protect against mundane attacks like spears, swords, or arrows.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 6''' — The ghost armor is a potential reward or goal for Simon.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 8''' — The ghost armor answers when one reaches out to Valinhall for power.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 17''' — Ghost armor can protect against Lirial's stars.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 20''' — Indirial can call ghost armor.}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|'''Ch 25''' — Simon can call ghost armor, which appears as spectral green armor.}}
